_comment: Trimmed capture of ~/.claude.json (2026-07-01). The live file is Claude Code
runtime state (76 keys: caches, per-project session metrics, account/machine
IDs, the full worktree directory map) and must NOT be tracked verbatim in a
public repo. Only the durable, restore-worthy config is captured here.
HACKMD_API_TOKEN is redacted — restore it from a secret store (agenix /
1Password); the same token is also configured in Claude Desktop's
projectMcpServers is a reference section (not a real ~/.claude.json key):
the deduped per-project MCP servers found across the live file's projects
map. Re-add per project with `claude mcp add`.
